summary: DailyHub AI backend tested end-to-end via public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All 24 pytest tests passed (100%). Covered: health, guest auth (create/me/logout/invalid-token 401), Emergent session exchange (invalid_id -> 401), Notes/Todos/Habits/Focus CRUD with user isolation, _id leakage check on every response, AI chat with multi-turn context (Gemini 3 Flash via Emergent LLM Key remembers 'teal'), AI history ordering, and all AI one-shot tools (translate/grammar/summarize/email/study) with 401 auth guards. Session document verified in Mongo to have expires_at/created_at/user_id (TTL structure).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~600 lines - approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider modularizing into routers (auth/notes/todos/habits/focus/ai) as features grow.
AI chat rebuilds context by concatenating history into the system_message every call - this works but token cost scales linearly. For long chats, consider trimming or summarizing older turns.

MONGO_URL/DB_NAME are accessed via os.environ[...] on import - correct fail-fast pattern; EMERGENT_LLM_KEY uses os.environ.get with '' default which will surface as an AI 500 later rather than at startup. Consider fail-fast for it too.

Notes/Todos PUT accepts the full NoteIn/TodoIn body so unspecified fields are reset to defaults (e.g., PUT without 'pinned' would set pinned=False). Not a bug now since UI sends full body, but PATCH semantics would be safer.
seed_data_creation: Guest users named TEST_User / TEST_User2 / TEST_Logout / TEST_TTL created for isolation and session tests; test-created notes/todos/habits/focus were cleaned up within tests where applicable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL comes from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). All /api routes verified reachable via ingress. Guest auth is the primary token source. AI tests use ~20-30s total; keep AI_TIMEOUT=60. Pytest runs with xdist (2 workers) via /app/backend/pytest.ini.
